highlights.title: Goals that need you show in the Inbox
highlights.text: When a goal needs you, say a fix is ready for your OK, it now shows under Needs you in the Inbox with the reason. Tap it to open the goal on the Mission board.

highlights.title: A goal's heartbeat shows every check
highlights.text: Each check of a goal now adds a square to its heartbeat, so a healthy goal reads "3/3 ok · Steady". The timeline keeps to what happened, with no hourly "Checked" lines.

highlights.title: A goal's timeline says what happened
highlights.text: A goal's history now reads in plain words and names the bot, like "First check: OK" or "Told you it broke". "Waiting for your OK" shows only once a fix really waits for you.

highlights.title: A goal notice opens the goal
highlights.text: Tap a notice about a goal and kwant opens that goal on the Mission board with its details, instead of the bot's empty chat. With the board off, the chat opens as before.

fixes: A goal's Fix task now has to pass the goal's own test, so it can't pass on a weaker one.
A goal that breaks again the same day still tells you, and its questions for you are no longer held back by the alert limit.
Homebrew builds of kwnt no longer look for new releases themselves; Homebrew updates them.
On a phone, Show details on an approval opens on the first tap, even right after typing.
On a phone, a link to the Mission board, Parallel Universe or Dev desk opens that page, not the chat list.
A goal no fix can be tested for now moves to Needs you and says why, instead of sitting broken with no word.
